scope: ST052-M linear-temporal child sampled-grid export only

user_requirement: The delivery target remains a callable 3D time-varying velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w].
Save/load support must not conflate a finite sampled grid with the underlying continuous callable velocity field.
public_source_fact: No public-source evidence used by this contract identifies this finite repository-created grid as an exact OpenAI velocity field or as the unpublished paper-exact field.
autonomous_design: The integrated grid-export adapter samples the authenticated ST052-M linear-temporal whole child on a 33x33x33 Cartesian grid over [-2,2]^3.
The integrated adapter samples five times: 0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.625, and 0.75.
NPZ/MAT payload equality and the 5e-12 callable-at-grid-node replay tolerance are engineering serialization/replay checks, not PDE, visualization, or source-correspondence acceptance thresholds.
pending_unknown: Any off-grid interpolation rule for the serialized grid unless a downstream consumer separately specifies and versions one.
Any verified bound on off-grid interpolation error relative to the source callable velocity.
Continuous derivative equivalence between a grid-derived interpolant and the source callable velocity.
PDE validation of any grid-derived interpolated field.
Visual correspondence, paper exactness, or identity with an unpublished OpenAI field.

nonuniqueness_witness.description: On the frozen x grid, delta(x)=sin(pi*(x-x_min)/h) vanishes at every serialized x node but is nonzero at half-grid points. Adding delta to one velocity component therefore leaves every serialized 4D grid sample unchanged while changing an off-grid continuous field.
nonuniqueness_witness.purpose: representation-scope witness only; not a candidate modification and not a PDE or visual test
